Special Primary Election: 6/11/2022; Special General Election: 8/16/2022. ** Don Young (R)- **  Alaska utilized a Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) method for the special general election and a "Top 4" method for the special primary election.  In Alaska's "Top 4" primary election method, the top four vote-getters in the primary election advance to the general election regardless of party affiliation.

Democratic Party Convention: 6/28/2023; Special General Election: 11/21/2023. Rep.Chris Stewart (R) Conventions are held by the political parties prior to the primary election.  If one candidate achieves the required convention vote (in accordance with party rules) and there are no candidates that qualified for a primary election by gathering petition signatures, then the candidate is the nominee and the primary election is not held.  There can be multiple rounds of balloting at the party conventions.  The Republican and Libertarian Party conventions were held on June 24, 2023, and the Democratic Party convention was held on June 28, 2023.  The United Utah Party convention date was June 27, 2023, and the Constitution Party convention date was July 1, 2023.  Convention nominees are noted with an asterisk.
